title: Acidic Tender Kenyan Rice Flour Crepe
description: A midnight craving dessert that balances sour lemon, sweet rice flour, and umami miso into tender crepes.
instructions: In a bowl whisk the sweet rice flour, salt, sugar, miso paste, and lemon juice until smooth.
Add water gradually until the batter reaches thin crepe consistency.
Let the batter rest for 10 minutes to hydrate the flour.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and brush lightly with coconut oil.
Pour a ladleful of batter into the pan, tilting to spread it thin.
Cook the crepe for 1–2 minutes until edges lift, then flip and cook 30 seconds more.
Transfer the finished crepe to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Garnish each crepe with fresh mint and serve warm or at room temperature.
